svg.title: Amiga workflow: details and recovery
svg.desc: Companion to the main workflow map. Sections link to the owning operations for startup, planning, source selection, review, publication and closure recovery.

g.text: Start or restore shared capture
Main session routes, host operator acts
Reuse healthy services. Provision if absent and recover if stopped.
Maintenance needs a selected window and closed active intervals.
Confirm a fresh event after service handoff.
Register and confirm the archived event
Main session
Identify the task, execution and actual Codex thread.
If export needs a finished turn, complete a short control turn.
Retry confirmation within the same deadline and registration.
If confirmation fails, report the stage and keep work paused.
Draft, save and approve a plan

a.text: Edit one working draft in conversation

g.text: Main session
TA-planner
TA-test-designer
Show material changes since approval and their effect on acceptance.
Keep an old result and record guidance when selection needs it.
Start or resume at the recorded stage
Main session

a.text: Resume and amend the working plan

g.text: Compare the inputs needed by the next stage before relying on them.
Keep the current round and resume only outstanding authorized work.
Select one task or a combined assembly

a.text: Declare, discover and select exact eligible sources

g.text: Main session
Record the named task branch, selected commit and local master tip. Offer a combined choice when several sources are eligible.
If an offer changes, refresh it. If another source is ineligible, the already selected eligible task can proceed. If published, check its record.
A working commit, missing confirmation, pending closure or combined selection requires full acceptance.
Prepare the complete integrated candidate
Main session
TA-code-reviewer
Documentation reviewer or main session

a.text: Batch scope, partition and required evidence

g.text: Reuse applicable evidence and resolve required gaps before freeze.
Get four independent verdicts
Four fresh TA-code-reviewers assess their assigned lanes.

a.text: A required issue or missing evidence

g.text: Apply the review checkpoint before more work
Main session
At round three or later, a known unresolved issue stops new work. Collect healthy work already running on the same candidate.
Record the actual choice: accept scoped issues, authorize one more round, or pause. Required gates and verdicts still govern readiness.
A valid continuation first collects any primary reports needed by a pending challenge, then uses the recorded scope once.

a.text: Commit working changes by explicit authority

g.text: An authorized working commit records the blockers and returns through the full acceptance route.
Challenge collected required findings
Fresh TA-code-reviewer

a.text: Claim and assess the complete collection

g.text: Check the supported sequence and what the test setup supplied.
Upheld findings remain open. Rejected findings close on that candidate.
Missing, incomplete or stale evidence leaves the handoff pending.

a.text: Select an upheld repair or resume evidence

g.text: Repair or retry the affected evidence
TA-implementer, for selected findings
Main session, for a selected check
Keep original triggers and IDs. Reprepare if the candidate changes.

a.text: Run the applicable checks and reviews

g.text: Carry forward evidence whose inputs still match.
Recover a failed full English scan
Main session
Fix the scanner error or resolve retained language findings.
If source changed, refresh applicable verification and reviews.
Seal the corrected commit and run the full scan again.
Recover a refused or interrupted publication
Main session
On a moved target, recheck selected sources against the new master.
Repeat applicable reconciliation, acceptance and the sealed scan.
Recover a known interrupted transition from its native phase record.
Unknown interference or effects outside authority need a decision.
Resume unfinished post-publication work
Main session
Retry only the unfinished published graph stage.
Shared services continue to run.
Preserve the required files before removing a checkout.
Let telemetry flush before closing its interval. Keep the source while a required file is active or unavailable.
Hand off services if needed, then clean up selected sources

a.text: Check installed services and their owning checkout

g.text: Main session
Complete a selected service handoff or keep the affected worktree while it is needed.
Main session, with confirmed publication, preservation and cleanup authority
If removal is partly complete, retry from the surviving record. The assembly checkout is removed last when selected.
Select verification for the actual trigger
Main session uses the canonical commit profile for the exact candidate.
Main session, at actual roadmap or milestone closure
TA-code-reviewer
Main session, when explicitly selected
At milestone closure, the required profile includes exhaustive SingleStep testing. A scoped English audit uses the selected files.
Local publication has its own full English scan on the exact accepted, sealed commit.
